checks.procedure: Generate all lengths 0–11 and a minimal valid header; assert explicit rejection or success.
Truncate each section/field boundary; vary counts and RDLENGTH to exceed remaining bytes; check bounded errors.
Use legal compression, self/two-node cycles, invalid offsets, missing terminators and label/name boundary lengths.
Parse synthetic unknown-type records and compare opaque bytes including pointer-like payloads.
For every configured resource budget, exercise the boundary and one unit above it; assert resource-limit errors.

limitations: No parser implementation or runtime tests exist in this contribution.
The spec is draft and requires domain/security review.
